address: Tottington Manor, Edburton Rd, Henfield, West Sussex,BN5 9LJ
bio: At TERRA, the Afternoon Teas are beautifully made in-house by their pastry chef using only the finest ingredients of the Sussex region. Dripping in contemporary luxury, sit back and relax in the beautiful restaurant, with exquisite views of the South Downs.  The Afternoon Tea experience begins with guest’s choice of twelve blends of local Hoogly Teas, or a selection of Coffees. The hot drinks are unlimited, with the option to elevate your experience with a glass of bubbly or an Afternoon Tea cocktail. Changing with the seasons, the Afternoon Tea offers a tiered selection of Chef’s Choice Finger Sandwiches, Savoury Pastries, Plain Scones with Clotted Cream & Sussex Jam, plus a delectable range of Sweet Treats.  Look out for their tailored Afternoon Tea experiences for seasonal celebrations such as Mother’s & Father’s Day, as well as a Festive Afternoon Tea throughout December.  Please note that as all Afternoon Teas are made fresh to order, so the venue require 48 hours’ notice of all Afternoon Tea bookings.
